title: Wheel and tyre sensor
description: Truck wheel assembly with the EcoStream cap-mount tyre-pressure sensor.

parts.label: Wheel hub
parts.description: Bolts the wheel to the axle and carries the wheel bearings.

parts.label: Steel disc rim
parts.description: 22.5-inch steel rim. Holds the tyre bead; the hand holes cool the brakes.

parts.label: Truck tyre 295/80 R22.5
parts.description: Tubeless radial truck tyre, about 1.04 m tall. EcoStream watches its pressure and temperature.

parts.label: Wheel nuts (10)
parts.description: Ten nuts on a 335 mm circle clamp the rim to the hub.

parts.label: Valve stem
parts.description: Where air goes in. The EcoStream sensor screws on in place of the valve cap.

parts.label: EcoStream tyre sensor
parts.description: Sealed cap-mount sensor. Reads tyre pressure and temperature and radios them to the in-cab unit.

parts.label: EcoStream tyre sensor
parts.description: Sealed cap-mount sensor. Reads tyre pressure and temperature and radios them to the in-cab unit.
